+
+bool SimuControl::GenerateSurfaceToVolumeIndexing(const std::string &physSurface, const std::string &physVolume)
+{
+    // slow and naive
+    PROFILE_FUNCTION();
+
+    auto surfTag = m_mesh->NameToTag(physSurface);
+    if (surfTag == 0)
+    {
+        LOG_CRITICAL("Cant find surface: {}", physSurface);
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    auto volTag = m_mesh->NameToTag(physVolume);
+    if (volTag == 0)
+    {
+        LOG_CRITICAL("Cant find volume: {}", physVolume);
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    // get surface elemetns
+    std::vector<ETriangle> triangles;
+    for (const auto &key_surf : m_mesh->GetSurfaces())
+    {
+        if (key_surf.second.physicalTag == surfTag)
+        {
+            for (const auto &elem : key_surf.second.elements)
+            {
+                triangles.push_back(elem);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    std::vector<size_t> indexForSaving;
+    indexForSaving.resize(triangles.size());
+
+    // true if tetrahedron contains the triangle
+    auto hasTriang = [](const ETetrahedron &tet, const ETriangle &tri) {
+        int count = 0;
+        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) // tri node
+        {
+            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) // tet node
+            {
+                if (tri.node[i] == tet.node[j])
+                {
+                    count++;
+                    break; // jump to the next triangle node
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (count == 3)
+            return true;
+
+        return false;
+    };
+
+    // for every volume
+    for (const auto &key_vol : m_mesh->GetVolumes())
+    {
+        // if volume has this physical tag
+        if (key_vol.second.physicalTag == volTag)
+        {
+            // for every tet index in this volume
+            for (size_t tetIndex = key_vol.second.firstElementIndex;
+                 tetIndex < key_vol.second.firstElementIndex + key_vol.second.numElements; tetIndex++)
+            {
+                const auto &tet = m_mesh->GetTetrahedron(tetIndex);
+
+                // for every triangle
+                for (size_t triIndex = 0; triIndex < triangles.size(); triIndex++)
+                {
+                    // is tet has the triangle
+                    if (hasTriang(tet, triangles[triIndex]))
+                    {
+                        indexForSaving.at(triIndex) = tetIndex;
+                        break; // jump to the next tetrahedron
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    m_chargeIndexToSave.emplace(physSurface, indexForSaving);
+
+    return true;
 }

+            return false;

+
+    return true;

+int64_t Mesh::FindElementByCoords(double x, double y, double z) const
+{
+    // convect coords to vector
+    Vec3 point = {x, y, z};
+
+    auto &candidates = m_topologyTree.Find(x, y, z);
+
+    if (candidates.empty())
+    {
+        // point is outside of the geometry
+        LOG_ERROR("Point is outside of the geometry: ({},{},{})", x, y, z);
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    // check every tetrahedron in the candidates list
+    for (auto index : candidates)
+    {
+        auto &elem = m_bulkElements.at(index);
+
+        // check if point is indide tetrahedron by
+        // checking if it is to the right side of each
+        // tetrahedrons face
+
+        Vec3 node0 = {m_Nodes.at(elem.node[0]).x, m_Nodes.at(elem.node[0]).y, m_Nodes.at(elem.node[0]).z};
+        Vec3 node1 = {m_Nodes.at(elem.node[1]).x, m_Nodes.at(elem.node[1]).y, m_Nodes.at(elem.node[1]).z};
+        Vec3 node2 = {m_Nodes.at(elem.node[2]).x, m_Nodes.at(elem.node[2]).y, m_Nodes.at(elem.node[2]).z};
+        Vec3 node3 = {m_Nodes.at(elem.node[3]).x, m_Nodes.at(elem.node[3]).y, m_Nodes.at(elem.node[3]).z};
+
+        Vec3 vec01 = node1 - node0;
+        Vec3 vec02 = node2 - node0;
+        Vec3 vec03 = node3 - node0;
+        Vec3 vec21 = node1 - node2;
+        Vec3 vec23 = node3 - node2;
+
+        Vec3 vec0p = point - node0;
+
+        double s0 = (vec01.Cross(vec02)).Dot(vec0p);
+        double s1 = (vec03.Cross(vec01)).Dot(vec0p);
+        double s2 = (vec02.Cross(vec03)).Dot(vec0p);
+        double s3 = (vec21.Cross(vec23)).Dot(point - node2);
+
+        if (s0 > 0 && s1 > 0 && s2 > 0 && s3 > 0)
+        {
+            return index;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // failed to find tetrahedron in the candidate list
+    // may happen if the point is inside of the bounding box but outside of the edge tetrahedrons
+    // not crititcal if the algorythm is doing OK. Critical otherwise
+    LOG_ERROR("Can not find tetrahedron that contains the point: ({},{},{})", x, y, z);
+    return -2;
+}
+
+void Mesh::SaveSurfaceToFile(const std::string &physname, ToMatlab &file) const
+{
+    auto tag = NameToTag(physname);
+
+    if (tag == 0)
+    {
+        LOG_ERROR("Surface '{}' not found!", physname);
+    }
+
+    std::vector<double> x, y, z;
+    std::vector<std::array<size_t, 3>> newindex;
+    std::map<size_t, size_t> indexmap; // old - new
+
+    size_t count = 0;
+
+    for (auto &key_surf : m_surfaces)
+    {
+        auto &surf = key_surf.second;
+        if (surf.HasTag(tag))
+        {
+            for (auto &elem : surf.elements)
+            {
+                std::array<size_t, 3> newtriang{0};
+
+                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
+                {
+                    auto iter = indexmap.find(elem.node[i]);
+                    if (iter == indexmap.end()) // new entry
+                    {
+                        indexmap.emplace(std::make_pair(elem.node[i], count));
+                        newtriang[i] = count;
+                        count++;
+
+                        x.push_back(m_Nodes.at(elem.node[i]).x);
+                        y.push_back(m_Nodes.at(elem.node[i]).y);
+                        z.push_back(m_Nodes.at(elem.node[i]).z);
+                    }
+                    else // existing entry
+                    {
+                        newtriang[i] = iter->second;
+                    }
+                }
+
+                newindex.push_back(newtriang);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    auto size = newindex.size();
+    std::vector<size_t> tomatlabindex;
+    tomatlabindex.resize(size * 3);
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; i++)
+    {
+        tomatlabindex.at(i + size * 0) = newindex.at(i)[0] + 1; // +1 for matlab indexing
+        tomatlabindex.at(i + size * 1) = newindex.at(i)[1] + 1;
+        tomatlabindex.at(i + size * 2) = newindex.at(i)[2] + 1;
+    }
+
+    // removing spaces from name
+    std::string newname = physname;
+    auto newend = std::remove(newname.begin(), newname.end(), ' ');
+    newname.erase(newend, newname.end());
+
+    file.Write(x, newname + "_x");
+    file.Write(y, newname + "_y");
+    file.Write(z, newname + "_z");
+    file.WriteAsMatrix(tomatlabindex, size, 3, newname + "_T");
+}
+
+void Mesh::SaveNodesToFile(ToMatlab &file) const
+{
+    file.Write(GetNodesX(), "nodeX");
+    file.Write(GetNodesY(), "nodeY");
+    file.Write(GetNodesZ(), "nodeZ");
+}
+
+bool Mesh::ReadSection(std::ifstream &geofile, std::string s)
+{
+
+    // not critical path
+    // no need to inmplement switch with string to int mapping
+    if (s == "MeshFormat")
+    {
+        return ReadMeshFormat(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "PhysicalNames")
+    {
+        return ReadPhysicalNames(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "Entities")
+    {
+        return ReadEntities(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "PartitionedEntities")
+    {
+        return ReadPartitionedEntities(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "Nodes")
+    {
+        return ReadNodes(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "Elements")
+    {
+        return ReadElements(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "Periodic")
+    {
+        return ReadPeriodic(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "GhostElements")
+    {
+        return ReadGhostElements(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "Parametrizations")
+    {
+        return ReadParametrizations(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "NodeData")
+    {
+        return ReadNodeData(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "ElementData")
+    {
+        return ReadElementData(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "ElementNodeData")
+    {
+        return ReadElementNodeData(geofile);
+    }
+    else if (s == "InterpolationScheme")
+    {
+        return ReadInterpolationScheme(geofile);
+    }
+    else
+    {
+        LOG_WARN("Unknown section in geo file: {}", s);
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+bool Mesh::ReadMeshFormat(std::ifstream &geofile)
+{
+    geofile >> m_Version.first;
+    geofile.get(); // get . symbol
+    geofile >> m_Version.second;
+
+    LOG_TRACE("MESH version {}.{}", m_Version.first, m_Version.second);
+
+    int type;
+    int size;
+
+    geofile >> type >> size;
+
+    std::string end;
+    geofile.get(); // get \n
+    std::getline(geofile, end);
+    if (end == "$EndMeshFormat")
+        return true;
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+bool Mesh::ReadPhysicalNames(std::ifstream &geofile)
+{
+    int numNames;
+    geofile >> numNames;
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < numNames; i++)
+    {
+        PhisicalName pname;
+
+        geofile >> pname.dimention;
+        geofile >> pname.tag;
+        std::getline(geofile, pname.name);
+
+        // remove quotes and space characters
+        pname.name.erase(0, 2);                  // erase the first two characters
+        pname.name.erase(pname.name.size() - 1); // erase the last character
+
+        m_PhisicalNames.emplace(pname.name, pname);
+
+        LOG_TRACE("dim: {}, tag: {}, name: {}", pname.dimention, pname.tag, pname.name);
+    }
+
+    std::string end;
+    std::getline(geofile, end);
+    if (end == "$EndPhysicalNames")
+        return true;
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+bool Mesh::ReadEntities(std::ifstream &geofile)
+{
+    size_t numPoints;
+    size_t numCurves;
+    size_t numSurfaces;
+    size_t numVolumes;
+
+    geofile >> numPoints >> numCurves >> numSurfaces >> numVolumes;
+
+    // points
+    for (int i = 0; i < numPoints; i++)
+    {
+        int pointTag;
+        double X, Y, Z;
+
+        geofile >> pointTag >> X >> Y >> Z;
+
+        size_t numPhysicalTags;
+        geofile >> numPhysicalTags;
+
+        for (int j = 0; j < numPhysicalTags; j++)
+        {
+            int physicalTag;
+            geofile >> physicalTag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // curves
+    for (int i = 0; i < numCurves; i++)
+    {
+        int curveTag;
+        double minX, minY, minZ;
+        double maxX, maxY, maxZ;
+
+        geofile >> curveTag >> minX >> minY >> minZ >> maxX >> maxY >> maxZ;
+
+        size_t numPhysicalTags;
+        geofile >> numPhysicalTags;
+
+        for (int j = 0; j < numPhysicalTags; j++)
+        {
+            int physicalTag;
+            geofile >> physicalTag;
+        }
+
+        size_t numBoundingPoints;
+        geofile >> numBoundingPoints;
+        for (int j = 0; j < numBoundingPoints; j++)
+        {
+            int pointTag;
+            geofile >> pointTag;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // surfaces
+    for (int i = 0; i < numSurfaces; i++)
+    {
+        // buffer
+        Surface tmp;
+
+        // read to buffer
+        geofile >> tmp.entytyTag >> tmp.minX >> tmp.minY >> tmp.minZ >> tmp.maxX >> tmp.maxY >> tmp.maxZ;
+
+        size_t numPhysicalTags;
+        geofile >> numPhysicalTags;
+
+        if (numPhysicalTags > 1)
+        {
+            LOG_ERROR("Unsupported amount of physical tags. Surface {} has {} physical tags!", tmp.entytyTag,
+                      numPhysicalTags);
+        }
+
+        // read all tags. save last one
+        for (int j = 0; j < numPhysicalTags; j++)
+        {
+            int tmpPhysTag = 0;
+            geofile >> tmpPhysTag;
+            tmp.physicalTag = tmpPhysTag;
+        }
+
+        size_t numBoundingCurves;
+        geofile >> numBoundingCurves;
+        for (int j = 0; j < numBoundingCurves; j++)
+        {
+            int curveTag;
+            geofile >> curveTag;
+        }
+
+        // save
+        m_surfaces.emplace(tmp.entytyTag, tmp);
+    }
+
+    // volumes
+    for (int i = 0; i < numVolumes; i++)
+    {
+        // buffer
+        Volume tmp;
+
+        // read from file to buffer
+        geofile >> tmp.entytyTag >> tmp.minX >> tmp.minY >> tmp.minZ >> tmp.maxX >> tmp.maxY >> tmp.maxZ;
+
+        size_t numPhysicalTags;
+        geofile >> numPhysicalTags;
+
+        if (numPhysicalTags > 1)
+        {
+            LOG_ERROR("Unsupported amount of physical tags. Volume {} has {} physical tags!", tmp.entytyTag,
+                      numPhysicalTags);
+        }
+
+        // read all tags. save last one
+        for (int j = 0; j < numPhysicalTags; j++)
+        {
+            int tmpPhysTag = 0;
+            geofile >> tmpPhysTag;
+            tmp.physicalTag = tmpPhysTag;
+        }
+
+        size_t numBoundngSurfaces;
+        geofile >> numBoundngSurfaces;
+        for (int j = 0; j < numBoundngSurfaces; j++)
+        {
+            int surfaceTag;
+            geofile >> surfaceTag;
+        }
+
+        // save
+        m_volumes.emplace(tmp.entytyTag, tmp);
+    }
+
+    std::string end;
+    geofile.get(); // get \n
+    std::getline(geofile, end);
+    std::getline(geofile, end);
+    if (end == "$EndEntities")
+        return true;
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+bool Mesh::ReadPartitionedEntities(std::ifstream &geofile)
+{
+    std::string end;
+    std::getline(geofile, end, '$');
+    std::getline(geofile, end);
+    if (end == "EndPartitionedEntities")
+        return true;
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+bool Mesh::ReadElements(std::ifstream &geofile)
+{
+
+    size_t numEntityBlocks;
+    size_t numElements;
+    size_t minElementTag;
+    size_t maxElementTag;
+
+    geofile >> numEntityBlocks >> numElements >> minElementTag >> maxElementTag;
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < numEntityBlocks; i++)
+    {
+        int entityDim;
+        int entityTag;
+        int elementType;
+        size_t numElementsInBlock;
+
+        geofile >> entityDim >> entityTag >> elementType >> numElementsInBlock;
+
+        size_t elementTag;
+
+        switch (entityDim)
+        {
+        case 2: // surface
+        {
+            if (elementType != 2) // 3-node Triangle
+            {
+                LOG_ERROR("ERROR element type {} is not supported!", elementType);
+                return false;
+            }
+
+            // fill entity data
+            auto &surface = m_surfaces.find(entityTag)->second;
+            surface.numElements = numElementsInBlock;
+            surface.firstElementIndex = m_surfElements.size();
+
+            // read elements
+            for (int j = 0; j < numElementsInBlock; j++)
+            {
+                ETriangle element{0};
+
+                geofile >> elementTag >> element.node[0] >> element.node[1] >> element.node[2];
+
+                // gmsh indexing starts from 1
+                element.node[0] -= 1;
+                element.node[1] -= 1;
+                element.node[2] -= 1;
+
+                m_surfElements.push_back(element);
+            }
+            break;
+        }
+        case 3: // volume
+        {
+            if (elementType != 4) // 4-node Tetrahedron
+            {
+                LOG_ERROR("ERROR element type {} is not supported!", elementType);
+                return false;
+            }
+
+            // fill entity data
+            auto &volume = m_volumes.find(entityTag)->second;
+            volume.numElements = numElementsInBlock;
+            volume.firstElementIndex = m_bulkElements.size();
+
+            for (int j = 0; j < numElementsInBlock; j++)
+            {
+                ETetrahedron element{0};
+
+                geofile >> elementTag >> element.node[0] >> element.node[1] >> element.node[2] >> element.node[3];
+
+                // gmsh indexing starts from 1
+                element.node[0] -= 1;
+                element.node[1] -= 1;
+                element.node[2] -= 1;
+                element.node[3] -= 1;
+
+                m_bulkElements.push_back(element);
+            }
+            break;
+        }
+        default:
+            break;
+        } // switch
+
+    } // entity block
+
+    std::string end;
+    geofile.get(); // get \n
+    std::getline(geofile, end);
+    std::getline(geofile, end);
+    if (end == "$EndElements")
+        return true;
+
+    return false;
+}
+

+bool Mesh::ReadNodes(std::ifstream &geofile)
+{
+    size_t numEntityBlocks;
+    size_t numNodes;
+    size_t minNodeTag;
+    size_t maxNodeTag;
+    int entityDim;
+    int entityTag;
+    int parametric;
+    size_t numNodesInBlock;
+
+    geofile >> numEntityBlocks;
+    geofile >> numNodes;
+    geofile >> minNodeTag;
+    geofile >> maxNodeTag;
+
+    if (minNodeTag != 1)
+    {
+        LOG_CRITICAL("Ubnormal node indexing in mesh!");
+        assert(false);
+    }
+
+    m_Nodes.reserve(numNodes);
+    size_t prevNodeTag = 0;
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < numEntityBlocks; i++)
+    {
+        geofile >> entityDim;
+        geofile >> entityTag;
+        geofile >> parametric;
+        geofile >> numNodesInBlock;
+
+        size_t nodeTag;
+        for (int j = 0; j < numNodesInBlock; j++)
+        {
+
+            geofile >> nodeTag;
+
+            if (nodeTag - prevNodeTag != 1)
+            {
+                LOG_ERROR("Non consecutive node numbering: {} -> {}", prevNodeTag, nodeTag);
+            }
+            prevNodeTag = nodeTag;
+        }
+        for (int j = 0; j < numNodesInBlock; j++)
+        {
+            Node node;
+            geofile >> node.x;
+            geofile >> node.y;
+            geofile >> node.z;
+
+            m_Nodes.push_back(node);
+        }
+    }
+
+    std::string end;
+    geofile.get(); // get \n
+
+    std::getline(geofile, end);
+    if (end == "$EndNodes")
+        return true;
+
+    return false;
+}

+  public:
+    // static class
+    GJK() = delete;
+    static const uint8_t MAX_ITER = 15;
+
+    // return true if shapes intersect
+    static bool Check(const Box &b, const ETetrahedron &t, const std::vector<Node> &nodes)
+    {
+        // prebuild data
+        std::array<Eigen::Vector3d, 8> m_box;
+        std::array<Eigen::Vector3d, 4> m_tet;
+
+        m_box[0] = {b.xMin, b.yMin, b.zMin};
+        m_box[1] = {b.xMax, b.yMin, b.zMin};
+        m_box[2] = {b.xMax, b.yMax, b.zMin};
+        m_box[3] = {b.xMin, b.yMax, b.zMin};
+
+        m_box[4] = {b.xMin, b.yMin, b.zMax};
+        m_box[5] = {b.xMax, b.yMin, b.zMax};
+        m_box[6] = {b.xMax, b.yMax, b.zMax};
+        m_box[7] = {b.xMin, b.yMax, b.zMax};
+
+        m_tet[0] = {nodes.at(t.node[0]).x, nodes.at(t.node[0]).y, nodes.at(t.node[0]).z};
+        m_tet[1] = {nodes.at(t.node[1]).x, nodes.at(t.node[1]).y, nodes.at(t.node[1]).z};
+        m_tet[2] = {nodes.at(t.node[2]).x, nodes.at(t.node[2]).y, nodes.at(t.node[2]).z};
+        m_tet[3] = {nodes.at(t.node[3]).x, nodes.at(t.node[3]).y, nodes.at(t.node[3]).z};
+
+        // box center
+        Eigen::Vector3d centerB, centerT;
+        centerB.x() = (b.xMax + b.xMin) / 2.0;
+        centerB.y() = (b.yMax + b.yMin) / 2.0;
+        centerB.z() = (b.zMax + b.zMin) / 2.0;
+
+        // tetrahedron center
+        centerT.x() =
+            (nodes.at(t.node[0]).x + nodes.at(t.node[1]).x + nodes.at(t.node[2]).x + nodes.at(t.node[3]).x) / 4.0;
+        centerT.y() =
+            (nodes.at(t.node[0]).y + nodes.at(t.node[1]).y + nodes.at(t.node[2]).y + nodes.at(t.node[3]).y) / 4.0;
+        centerT.z() =
+            (nodes.at(t.node[0]).z + nodes.at(t.node[1]).z + nodes.at(t.node[2]).z + nodes.at(t.node[3]).z) / 4.0;
+
+        // center direction
+        Eigen::Vector3d dir = centerT - centerB;
+        dir.normalize();
+
+        // find first support point
+        std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> m_simplex;
+        m_simplex.reserve(4);
+
+        m_simplex.push_back(Support(m_box, m_tet, dir));
+
+        // new direction towards the origin
+        dir = -m_simplex.at(0);
+
+        int iter = 1;
+
+        while (true)
+        {
+            // new support point
+            Eigen::Vector3d A = Support(m_box, m_tet, dir);
+            if (A.dot(dir) < 0) // no intersection
+            {
+                // std::cout << "No intersection" << std::endl;
+                // std::cout << "GJK iterations " << iter << std::endl;
+
+                // LOG
+                // LOG(b, m_tet, false);
+                return false;
+            }
+
+            // add new point to a simplex
+            m_simplex.push_back(A);
+            if (HandleSimplex(m_simplex, dir))
+            {
+                // std::cout << "Intersection found!" << std::endl;
+                // std::cout << "GJK iterations " << iter << std::endl;
+                //  LOG
+                // LOG(b, m_tet, true);
+                return true;
+            }
+
+            iter++;
+
+            if (iter > MAX_ITER)
+            {
+                // LOG_TRACE("GJK to many iterations: {}", iter);
+                // LOG(b, m_tet);
+
+                // most of the time there is no intersection
+                return false; // FIXME: Consider returning true for reliability
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+  private:
+    static void LOG(const Box &b, const std::array<Eigen::Vector3d, 4> &tet, bool result)
+    {
+#if (GJK_LOG == 1)
+        std::ofstream myfile;
+        myfile.open("GJKlog.txt", std::ios::app);
+
+        myfile << "box = [" << b.xMin << ", " << b.yMin << ", " << b.zMin << ", " << b.xMax << ", " << b.yMax << ", "
+               << b.zMax << "]\n";
+        myfile << "tet = [" << tet[0].x << ", " << tet[0].y << ", " << tet[0].z << '\n';
+        myfile << tet[1].x << ", " << tet[1].y << ", " << tet[1].z << '\n';
+        myfile << tet[2].x << ", " << tet[2].y << ", " << tet[2].z << '\n';
+        myfile << tet[3].x << ", " << tet[3].y << ", " << tet[3].z << "]\n";
+        if (result)
+        {
+            myfile << "HIT\n";
+        }
+        else
+        {
+            myfile << "MISS\n";
+        }
+        myfile << '\n';
+
+        myfile.close();
+#endif
+    }
+
+    static Eigen::Vector3d Support(const std::array<Eigen::Vector3d, 8> &box, const std::array<Eigen::Vector3d, 4> &tet,
+                                   const Eigen::Vector3d &dir)
+    {
+        // box furthest point
+        double maxVal = box[0].dot(dir);
+        int maxIDbox = 0;
+        for (int i = 1; i < 8; i++)
+        {
+            double curVal = box[i].dot(dir);
+            if (curVal > maxVal)
+            {
+                maxVal = curVal;
+                maxIDbox = i;
+            }
+        }
+
+        // tet furthest point
+        maxVal = tet[0].dot(-dir);
+        int maxIDtet = 0;
+        for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++)
+        {
+            double curVal = tet[i].dot(-dir);
+            if (curVal > maxVal)
+            {
+                maxVal = curVal;
+                maxIDtet = i;
+            }
+        }
+
+        return box[maxIDbox] - tet[maxIDtet];
+    }
+
+    static bool LineCase(std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> &simp, Eigen::Vector3d &dir)
+    {
+        Eigen::Vector3d &A = simp[1];
+        Eigen::Vector3d &B = simp[0];
+
+        Eigen::Vector3d AB = B - A;
+        Eigen::Vector3d AO = -A;
+
+        if (AB.dot(AO) > 0)
+        {
+            // origin is in the AB region
+            // perp to a AB towards the origin
+            Eigen::Vector3d ABperp = AB.cross(AO).cross(AB);
+            ABperp.normalize();
+            dir = ABperp;
+        }
+        else
+        {
+            // origin is not between first and second point
+            // delete first point and set direction from A to the origin;
+            simp.erase(simp.begin());
+            dir = AO;
+        }
+
+        // return false -> Add new point to the simplex
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    static bool TriangleCase(std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> &simp, Eigen::Vector3d &dir)
+    {
+        Eigen::Vector3d AB = simp[1] - simp[2]; // B - A
+        Eigen::Vector3d AC = simp[0] - simp[2]; // C - A
+        Eigen::Vector3d AO = -simp[2];          // -A
+
+        // perp of ABC triangle
+        Eigen::Vector3d ABC = AB.cross(AC);
+
+        // Check AC
+        if (ABC.cross(AC).dot(AO) > 0)
+        {
+            if (AC.dot(AO) > 0)
+            {
+                // detelete B point
+                // and set direction from AC towards the origin
+                simp.erase(std::next(simp.begin(), 1));
+                dir = AC.cross(AO).cross(AC);
+            }
+            else
+            {
+                // delete C point
+                // AB line case
+                simp.erase(simp.begin());
+                return LineCase(simp, dir);
+            }
+        }
+        // Check AB
+        else
+        {
+            if (AB.cross(ABC).dot(AO) > 0)
+            {
+                // detelete C point
+                // and set direction from AB towards the origin
+                simp.erase(simp.begin());
+                return LineCase(simp, dir);
+            }
+            else
+            {
+                // triangle contains the origin
+                if (ABC.dot(AO) > 0)
+                {
+                    dir = ABC;
+                }
+                else
+                {
+                    // swap B and C points
+                    std::swap(simp[0], simp[1]);
+                    dir = -ABC;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        // return false -> Add new point to the simplex
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    static bool TetrahedronCase(std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> &simp, Eigen::Vector3d &dir)
+    {
+        Eigen::Vector3d AB = simp[2] - simp[3]; // B - A
+        Eigen::Vector3d AC = simp[1] - simp[3]; // C - A
+        Eigen::Vector3d AD = simp[0] - simp[3]; // D - A
+        Eigen::Vector3d AO = -simp[3];          // -A
+
+        // perp facing ouside of the tetrahedron
+        Eigen::Vector3d ABC = AB.cross(AC);
+        Eigen::Vector3d ACD = AC.cross(AD);
+        Eigen::Vector3d ADB = AD.cross(AB);
+
+        // check if origin is outside of the tetrahedron
+        if (ABC.dot(AO) > 0)
+        {
+            // Delete D point
+            simp.erase(simp.begin());
+
+            return TriangleCase(simp, dir);
+        }
+        if (ACD.dot(AO) > 0)
+        {
+            // Delete B point
+            simp.erase(std::next(simp.begin(), 2));
+
+            return TriangleCase(simp, dir);
+        }
+        if (ADB.dot(AO) > 0)
+        {
+            //  Delete C point
+            simp.erase(std::next(simp.begin(), 1));
+
+            // swap B and D points
+            std::swap(simp[0], simp[1]);
+
+            return TriangleCase(simp, dir);
+        }
+
+        // origin is inside the tetrahedron
+        // intersection found
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    static bool HandleSimplex(std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> &simp, Eigen::Vector3d &dir)
+    {
+        switch (simp.size())
+        {
+        case 2: // line simplex
+        {
+            return LineCase(simp, dir);
+        }
+        case 3: // triangle simplex
+        {
+            return TriangleCase(simp, dir);
+        }
+        case 4: // tetrahedron simplex
+        {
+            return TetrahedronCase(simp, dir);
+        }
+        default:
+            std::cout << "[ERROR] GJK::Unknows Simplex size!" << std::endl;
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
 };

+bool TopologyTree::GenerateData(const std::map<int, Volume> &volumes, const std::vector<ETetrahedron> &elements,
+                                const std::vector<Node> &nodes)
+{
+    // if no geometry available
+    size_t numnodes = nodes.size();
+
+    if (elements.size() == 0 || numnodes == 0 || volumes.size() == 0)
+    {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    // create root node
+    //
+    // bounding box
+    Box box;
+
+    // update bounding box
+    for (auto &pair : volumes)
+    {
+        auto &v = pair.second;
+
+        box.xMax = box.xMax < v.maxX ? v.maxX : box.xMax;
+        box.yMax = box.yMax < v.maxY ? v.maxY : box.yMax;
+        box.zMax = box.zMax < v.maxZ ? v.maxZ : box.zMax;
+
+        box.xMin = box.xMin > v.minX ? v.minX : box.xMin;
+        box.yMin = box.yMin > v.minY ? v.minY : box.yMin;
+        box.zMin = box.zMin > v.minZ ? v.minZ : box.zMin;
+    }
+
+    // add bounding box to the root of topology tree;
+    m_topologyTree.clear();
+    m_topologyTree.reserve(2 * numnodes);
+    m_topologyTree.emplace_back();
+    m_topologyTree.at(0).boundBox = box;
+
+    // fill topology tree root with elements
+    for (int i = 0; i < elements.size(); i++)
+    {
+        m_topologyTree.at(0).elements.push_back(i);
+    }
+
+    // make box slightly bigger to ensure that edges are inside
+    // m_topologyTree.at(0).boundBox.xMax += 0.01;
+    // m_topologyTree.at(0).boundBox.yMax += 0.01;
+    // m_topologyTree.at(0).boundBox.zMax += 0.01;
+
+    // m_topologyTree.at(0).boundBox.xMin -= 0.01;
+    // m_topologyTree.at(0).boundBox.yMin -= 0.01;
+    // m_topologyTree.at(0).boundBox.zMin -= 0.01;
+
+    BuildTopologyRecursive(0, elements, nodes);
+
+    // statistics
+    m_maxTetrahedronsAtNode = 0;
+
+    for (auto &node : m_topologyTree)
+    {
+        m_maxTetrahedronsAtNode =
+            node.elements.size() > m_maxTetrahedronsAtNode ? node.elements.size() : m_maxTetrahedronsAtNode;
+    }
+
+    return true;
+}
+
+const std::vector<size_t> &TopologyTree::Find(double x, double y, double z) const
+{
+    // check if point is inside bounding box
+    if (!IsInBounds(x, y, z))
+    {
+        // returns empty vector
+        LOG_ERROR("Looking for point outside of the bounding box!");
+        return m_emptyVector;
+    }
+
+    // find node that contains elements
+    size_t currTreeNode = 0;
+    while (m_topologyTree.at(currTreeNode).elements.empty())
+    {
+        auto left = m_topologyTree.at(currTreeNode).left;
+        auto right = m_topologyTree.at(currTreeNode).right;
+
+        if (m_topologyTree.at(left).boundBox.Contains(x, y, z))
+        {
+            // search left
+            currTreeNode = left;
+        }
+        else
+        {
+            // search right
+            currTreeNode = right;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // return list of elements
+    return m_topologyTree.at(currTreeNode).elements;
 }

+void TopologyTree::BuildTopologyRecursive(size_t parentID, const std::vector<ETetrahedron> &elements,
+                                          const std::vector<Node> &nodes)
+{
+    // create new tree branches
+    m_topologyTree.emplace_back();
+    size_t leftID = m_topologyTree.size() - 1;
+    m_topologyTree.at(parentID).left = leftID;
+
+    m_topologyTree.emplace_back();
+    size_t rightID = m_topologyTree.size() - 1;
+    m_topologyTree.at(parentID).right = rightID;
+
+    // create local reffs after expanding tree vector
+    treeNode &parent = m_topologyTree.at(parentID);
+    treeNode &left = m_topologyTree.at(leftID);
+    treeNode &right = m_topologyTree.at(rightID);
+
+    // split parent bounding box into two
+    parent.boundBox.Split(left.boundBox, right.boundBox);
+
+    size_t numelems = parent.elements.size();
+
+    // search for elements in new boxes
+    std::vector<size_t> nodesLeft, nodesRight; // unique nodes in the box
+    nodesLeft.reserve(numelems * 4);
+    nodesRight.reserve(numelems * 4);
+
+    for (auto index : parent.elements)
+    {
+        auto &element = elements.at(index);
+
+        bool contains = false;
+        // left box.  check every tetrahedron node
+        if (left.boundBox.Contains(nodes.at(element.node[0]).x, nodes.at(element.node[0]).y,
+                                   nodes.at(element.node[0]).z))
+        {
+            nodesLeft.push_back(element.node[0]);
+            contains = true;
+        }
+        if (left.boundBox.Contains(nodes.at(element.node[1]).x, nodes.at(element.node[1]).y,
+                                   nodes.at(element.node[1]).z))
+        {
+            nodesLeft.push_back(element.node[1]);
+            contains = true;
+        }
+        if (left.boundBox.Contains(nodes.at(element.node[2]).x, nodes.at(element.node[2]).y,
+                                   nodes.at(element.node[2]).z))
+        {
+            nodesLeft.push_back(element.node[2]);
+            contains = true;
+        }
+        if (left.boundBox.Contains(nodes.at(element.node[3]).x, nodes.at(element.node[3]).y,
+                                   nodes.at(element.node[3]).z))
+        {
+            nodesLeft.push_back(element.node[3]);
+            contains = true;
+        }
+
+        if (!contains) // if nodes are not in the box perform GJK test
+            contains = GJK::Check(left.boundBox, element, nodes);
+
+        if (contains)
+            left.elements.push_back(index);
+
+        // right box. check every tetrahedron node
+        contains = false;
+
+        if (right.boundBox.Contains(nodes.at(element.node[0]).x, nodes.at(element.node[0]).y,
+                                    nodes.at(element.node[0]).z))
+        {
+            nodesRight.push_back(element.node[0]);
+            contains = true;
+        }
+        if (right.boundBox.Contains(nodes.at(element.node[1]).x, nodes.at(element.node[1]).y,
+                                    nodes.at(element.node[1]).z))
+        {
+            nodesRight.push_back(element.node[1]);
+            contains = true;
+        }
+        if (right.boundBox.Contains(nodes.at(element.node[2]).x, nodes.at(element.node[2]).y,
+                                    nodes.at(element.node[2]).z))
+        {
+            nodesRight.push_back(element.node[2]);
+            contains = true;
+        }
+        if (right.boundBox.Contains(nodes.at(element.node[3]).x, nodes.at(element.node[3]).y,
+                                    nodes.at(element.node[3]).z))
+        {
+            nodesRight.push_back(element.node[3]);
+            contains = true;
+        }
+
+        if (!contains) // if nodes are not in the box perform GJK test
+            contains = GJK::Check(right.boundBox, element, nodes);
+
+        if (contains)
+            right.elements.push_back(index);
+    }
+
+    // clear parent element array
+    {
+        std::vector<size_t> tmp;
+        parent.elements.swap(tmp);
+        // tmp deletes here
+    }
+
+    auto isUnique = [](const std::vector<size_t> &vec) {
+        if (vec.empty())
+        {
+            return true;
+        }
+
+        size_t prev = vec[0];
+        for (size_t i = 1; i < vec.size(); i++)
+        {
+            if (prev != vec[i])
+            {
+                return false;
+            }
+        }
+
+        return true;
+    };
+
+    if (!isUnique(nodesLeft))
+    {
+        {
+            std::vector<size_t> tmp;
+            nodesLeft.swap(tmp);
+        }
+        BuildTopologyRecursive(leftID, elements, nodes);
+    }
+
+    if (!isUnique(nodesRight))
+    {
+        {
+            std::vector<size_t> tmp;
+            nodesRight.swap(tmp);
+        }
+        BuildTopologyRecursive(rightID, elements, nodes);
+    }
+}

+bool Beam::SaveTracksToFile(ToMatlab &file, uint32_t numPoints)
+{
+    file.StartCell("tracks", m_tracks.size());
+
+    std::vector<double> coords;
+    coords.reserve(numPoints);
+
+    for (auto &track : m_tracks)
+    {
+        auto &points = track.GetPoints();
+        auto pointsSize = points.size();
+        auto coordsSize = pointsSize;
+
+        double step = 1.0;
+        if (pointsSize > numPoints)
+        {
+            step = (double)pointsSize / (double)(numPoints - 1);
+            coordsSize = numPoints;
+        }
+
+        // reserve for x y and z
+        coords.resize(coordsSize * 3);
+
+        // writing column major matrix as vector
+
+        // writing the first point
+        coords.at(coordsSize * 0) = points.at(0).x();
+        coords.at(coordsSize * 1) = points.at(0).y();
+        coords.at(coordsSize * 2) = points.at(0).z();
+
+        // writing all between the first and the second
+        for (size_t i = 1; i < coordsSize - 1; i++)
+        {
+            coords.at(i + coordsSize * 0) = points.at(i * step).x();
+            coords.at(i + coordsSize * 1) = points.at(i * step).y();
+            coords.at(i + coordsSize * 2) = points.at(i * step).z();
+        }
+
+        // writing the last point
+        coords.at(coordsSize - 1 + coordsSize * 0) = points.at(pointsSize - 1).x();
+        coords.at(coordsSize - 1 + coordsSize * 1) = points.at(pointsSize - 1).y();
+        coords.at(coordsSize - 1 + coordsSize * 2) = points.at(pointsSize - 1).z();
+
+        file.WriteCellAsMatrix(coords, coordsSize, 3);
+
+        coords.clear();
+    }
+
+    file.EndCell();
+
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool Beam::SaveTracksToFilePresice(ToMatlab &file)
+{
+    file.StartCell("tracks", m_tracks.size());
+
+    std::vector<double> coords;
+
+    for (auto &track : m_tracks)
+    {
+        auto &points = track.GetPoints();
+        auto size = points.size();
+
+        // reserve for x y and z
+        coords.resize(size * 3);
+
+        // writing column major matrix as vector
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; i++)
+        {
+            coords.at(i + size * 0) = points.at(i).x();
+            coords.at(i + size * 1) = points.at(i).y();
+            coords.at(i + size * 2) = points.at(i).z();
+        }
+
+        file.WriteCellAsMatrix(coords, size, 3);
+
+        coords.clear();
+    }
+
+    file.EndCell();
+
+    return true;
 }

+    // Isocell method
+    int N1 = 3;
+    int n = circles;
+
+    int numtracks = N1 * n * n;
+
+    double Rfacke = 2 * n * m_radius / (2 * n - 1);
+    double dr = Rfacke / n;
+    double A1 = phys::pi * dr * dr / N1;
+
+    auto centermass = [](const double R, const double phi) { return 4.0 / 3.0 * R * std::sin(phi / 2) / phi; };
+
+    auto area = [](const double R, const double phi) { return R * R * phi / 2; };
+
+    std::vector<double> x;
+    std::vector<double> y;
+    std::vector<double> z;
+
+    x.reserve(numtracks);
+    y.reserve(numtracks);
+    z.resize(numtracks); // zero initialized
+
+    for (int i = 1; i < n + 1; i++)
+    {
+        int N = std::round(phys::pi * dr * dr * (2 * i - 1) / A1);
+        double dphi = 2 * phys::pi / N;
+
+        double Rc = centermass(dr * i, dphi);
+        double rc = centermass(dr * (i - 1), dphi);
+
+        double AR = area(dr * i, dphi);
+        double Ar = area(dr * (i - 1), dphi);
+
+        double Rtotal = (AR * Rc - Ar * rc) / (AR - Ar); // radius to centermass of a sector
+
+        for (int Ni = 1; Ni < N + 1; Ni++)
+        {
+            x.push_back(Rtotal * std::cos(dphi * Ni));
+            y.push_back(Rtotal * std::sin(dphi * Ni));
+        }
+    }
+
+    // populating tracks with initial values
+    m_tracks.clear();
+    m_tracks.reserve(numtracks);
+
+    // rotate point to designated direction
+    auto rotation = Eigen::Quaterniond::FromTwoVectors(Eigen::Vector3d{0, 0, 1}, m_direction);
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < numtracks; i++)
+    {
+        Track t;
+        t.SetStartingPosition(rotation * Eigen::Vector3d{x.at(i), y.at(i), z.at(i)} + m_centerPosition);
+        m_tracks.push_back(t);
+    }

+    PROFILE_FUNCTION();
+
+    // initial speed value
+    double speed = phys::c * std::sqrt(1 - std::pow(m_particle.E0 / (m_energy + m_particle.E0), 2));
+
+    std::random_device rd;  // Will be used to obtain a seed for the random number engine
+    std::mt19937 gen(rd()); // Standard mersenne_twister_engine seeded with rd()
+    std::uniform_real_distribution<> div(0, m_divergence);
+    std::uniform_real_distribution<> fi(0, 2 * 3.1415);
+
+    // perpendicular to direction
+    Eigen::Vector3d randomVector = Eigen::Vector3d::Random();
+    Eigen::Vector3d perp = m_direction.cross(randomVector).normalized();
+
+    // setting initial values
+    for (int i = 0; i < m_tracks.size(); i++)
+    {
+        auto &track = m_tracks.at(i);
+        track.SetStepSize(m_stepSize);
+
+        // generate divergence from direction
+        Eigen::Vector3d dirdiv = Eigen::AngleAxis<double>(fi(gen), m_direction) * perp;
+        dirdiv = dirdiv * std::tan(div(gen));
+        Eigen::Vector3d newdir = (m_direction + dirdiv).normalized();
+        track.SetStartingVelocity(newdir * speed);
+
+        auto field = m_fieldFunction(track.GetLastPoint().x(), track.GetLastPoint().y(), track.GetLastPoint().z());
+        track.SetAcceleration(field * m_particle.charge / phys::me);
+    }
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)
+    for (int i = 0; i < m_tracks.size(); i++)
+    {
+        PROFILE_SCOPE("ONE TRACK RUN");
+
+        auto &track = m_tracks.at(i);
+        while (true)
+        {
+            auto &lastPoint = track.MakeStep();
+
+            // if we should stop
+            if (m_stoppingFunction(lastPoint.x(), lastPoint.y(), lastPoint.z()))
+            {
+                break;
+            }
+
+            auto field = m_fieldFunction(lastPoint.x(), lastPoint.y(), lastPoint.z());
+            track.SetAcceleration(field * m_particle.charge / phys::me);
+
+            track.CalcNewVelocity();
+        }
+    }
+}

+bool Solver::SetBoundaryValue(const std::string &name, double value)
+{
+    PROFILE_FUNCTION();
+
+    auto physTag = m_mesh->NameToTag(name);
+    bool found = false;
+
+    for (auto &key_surface : m_mesh->m_surfaces)
+    {
+        if (key_surface.second.HasTag(physTag))
+        {
+            found = true;
+
+            // separate boundary and inner indices
+            for (auto &element : key_surface.second.elements)
+            {
+                m_jIndex.Add(element.node[0]);
+                m_jIndex.Add(element.node[1]);
+                m_jIndex.Add(element.node[2]);
+
+                m_iIndex.RemoveInterval(element.node[0], element.node[0]);
+                m_iIndex.RemoveInterval(element.node[1], element.node[1]);
+                m_iIndex.RemoveInterval(element.node[2], element.node[2]);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    // boundary value vector resize
+    m_uBound.conservativeResize(m_jIndex.Size());
+
+    for (auto &key_surface : m_mesh->m_surfaces)
+    {
+        if (key_surface.second.HasTag(physTag))
+        {
+            // write boundary coefficients
+            for (auto &triangle : key_surface.second.elements)
+            {
+                m_uBound.coeffRef(m_jIndex.GetPositionOf(triangle.node[0])) = value;
+                m_uBound.coeffRef(m_jIndex.GetPositionOf(triangle.node[1])) = value;
+                m_uBound.coeffRef(m_jIndex.GetPositionOf(triangle.node[2])) = value;
+
+                m_u.coeffRef(triangle.node[0]) = value;
+                m_u.coeffRef(triangle.node[1]) = value;
+                m_u.coeffRef(triangle.node[2]) = value;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return found;
+}
+
+bool Solver::SetBoundaryValues(const std::vector<std::string> &names, const std::vector<double> values)
+{
+    PROFILE_FUNCTION();
+
+    // fool proof
+    if (names.size() != values.size())
+    {
+        LOG_CRITICAL("[SetBoundaryValues] Boundary names and values have different sizes!");
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    // reserving local storage for boundary indices
+    std::vector<UnsignedRange> tempjIndices(names.size());
+
+    // for every boundary
+    for (int i = 0; i < names.size(); i++)
+    {
+        auto physTag = m_mesh->NameToTag(names.at(i));
+
+        // find taged surface
+        bool found = false;
+        for (auto &key_surface : m_mesh->m_surfaces)
+        {
+            if (key_surface.second.HasTag(physTag))
+            {
+                found = true;
+
+                // write boundary indices to temp storage
+                for (auto &element : key_surface.second.elements)
+                {
+                    tempjIndices.at(i).Add(element.node[0]);
+                    tempjIndices.at(i).Add(element.node[1]);
+                    tempjIndices.at(i).Add(element.node[2]);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        if (!found)
+        {
+            LOG_CRITICAL("[SetBoundaryValues] Failed to find surfaces of {} boundary with physTag {}!", names.at(i),
+                         physTag);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // combining all indices
+    for (auto &range : tempjIndices)
+    {
+        m_jIndex = m_jIndex + range;
+        m_iIndex = m_iIndex - range;
+    }
+
+    // boundary value vector resize
+    m_uBound.conservativeResize(m_jIndex.Size());
+
+    // for every boundary
+    for (int i = 0; i < names.size(); i++)
+    {
+        auto physTag = m_mesh->NameToTag(names.at(i));
+
+        // find taged surface
+        for (auto &key_surface : m_mesh->m_surfaces)
+        {
+            if (key_surface.second.HasTag(physTag))
+            {
+                // write boundary coefficients
+                for (auto &triangle : key_surface.second.elements)
+                {
+                    // for every node in triangle
+                    for (int N = 0; N < 3; N++)
+                    {
+                        // find its value
+                        double value = 0;
+                        for (int rangeIndex = 0; rangeIndex < tempjIndices.size(); rangeIndex++)
+                        {
+                            if (tempjIndices.at(rangeIndex).Contains(triangle.node[N]))
+                            {
+                                value = values.at(rangeIndex);
+                                break; // if boundaries share nodes we take first value
+                            }
+                        }
+
+                        m_uBound.coeffRef(m_jIndex.GetPositionOf(triangle.node[N])) = value;
+                        m_u.coeffRef(triangle.node[N]) = value;
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return true;
 }

-
+    PROFILE_FUNCTION();
+
+    // iterative solver
+    Eigen::ConjugateGradient<Eigen::SparseMatrix<double>, Eigen::Lower | Eigen::Upper> cg;
+
+    // register right side
+    cg.compute(m_Kii);
+
+    // solve for left side
+    // Eigen::VectorXd uSolved = cg.solve(m_fi - m_Kij * m_uBound);
+    Eigen::VectorXd uSolved = cg.solveWithGuess(m_fi - m_Kij * m_uBound, m_uGuess);
+    m_uGuess = uSolved;
+
+    if (cg.info() != Eigen::ComputationInfo::Success)
+    {
+        LOG_CRITICAL("Failed to solve");
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    LOG_TRACE("Solved in {} iterations with the error of {}", cg.iterations(), cg.error());
+
+    // assemble full u
+    RangeIterator iIndex(m_iIndex);
+
+    for (size_t i = iIndex.Get(); i < iIndex.GetMax(); iIndex.Advance())
+    {
+        i = iIndex.Get();
+
+        m_u(i) = uSolved(m_iIndex.GetPositionOf(i));
+    }
+
+    RangeIterator jIndex(m_jIndex);
+
+    for (size_t j = jIndex.Get(); j < jIndex.GetMax(); jIndex.Advance())
+    {
+        j = jIndex.Get();
+
+        m_u(j) = m_uBound(m_jIndex.GetPositionOf(j));
+    }
+
+    // -------------------- when using avaraged field -------------------------------
+    if (m_fieldSmoothing) // calc mean of field at nodes
+    {
+        m_field.resize(m_u.size());
+
+        std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> elemField;
+        size_t numElem = m_mesh->GetBulkElements().size();
+        elemField.resize(numElem);
+
+        // first calc field at elements
+        for (size_t elemIndex = 0; elemIndex < numElem; elemIndex++)
+        {
+            auto &gradient = m_mesh->m_GradientVectors.at(elemIndex);
+            auto &element = m_mesh->m_bulkElements.at(elemIndex);
+
+            elemField.at(elemIndex) = -gradient.at(0) * m_u(element.node[0]) - gradient.at(1) * m_u(element.node[1]) -
+                                      gradient.at(2) * m_u(element.node[2]) - gradient.at(3) * m_u(element.node[3]);
+        }
+
+        // then calc mean
+        size_t numNodes = m_mesh->GetNodes().size();
+        for (size_t nodeindex = 0; nodeindex < numNodes; nodeindex++)
+        {
+            auto &node = m_mesh->GetNode(nodeindex);
+            auto &candidates = m_mesh->m_topologyTree.Find(node.x, node.y, node.z);
+
+            m_field.at(nodeindex).setZero();
+            int count = 0;
+            for (auto &candidateIndex : candidates)
+            {
+                auto &cand = m_mesh->GetTetrahedron(candidateIndex);
+
+                if (cand.node[0] == nodeindex || cand.node[1] == nodeindex || cand.node[2] == nodeindex ||
+                    cand.node[3] == nodeindex)
+                {
+                    count++;
+                    m_field.at(nodeindex) += elemField.at(candidateIndex);
+                }
+            }
+
+            if (count == 0)
+            {
+                LOG_ERROR("SKIBIDI");
+            }
+
+            m_field.at(nodeindex) = m_field.at(nodeindex).array() / count;
+        }
+    }
+
+    return true;
+}

+bool NodeToString(const fkyaml::basic_node<> &node, std::string &str)
+{
+    if (node.get_type() == fkyaml::node_type::STRING)
+    {
+        str = node.as_str();
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+template <typename T> bool NodeToInt(const fkyaml::basic_node<> &node, T &integer)
+{
+    static_assert(std::is_integral_v<T>, "Wrong type in template. Expected integer");
+
+    switch (node.get_type())
+    {
+    case fkyaml::node_type::INTEGER: {
+        integer = node.as_int();
+        return true;
+    }
+    case fkyaml::node_type::FLOAT: {
+        integer = node.as_float();
+        return true;
+    }
+    case fkyaml::node_type::STRING: {
+        try
+        {
+            integer = std::stoi(node.as_str());
+        }
+        catch (...)
+        {
+            LOG_CRITICAL("String to int failed. The string was: {}", node.as_str());
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        return true;
+    }
+    default:
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+template <typename T> bool NodeToDouble(const fkyaml::basic_node<> &node, T &floating)
+{
+    static_assert(std::is_floating_point_v<T>, "Wrong type in template. Expected floating");
+
+    switch (node.get_type())
+    {
+    case fkyaml::node_type::INTEGER: {
+        floating = node.as_int();
+        return true;
+    }
+    case fkyaml::node_type::FLOAT: {
+        floating = node.as_float();
+        return true;
+    }
+    case fkyaml::node_type::STRING: {
+        try
+        {
+            floating = std::stod(node.as_str());
+        }
+        catch (...)
+        {
+            LOG_CRITICAL("String to double failed. The string was: {}", node.as_str());
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        return true;
+    }
+    default:
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+bool NodeToBool(const fkyaml::basic_node<> &node, bool &boolean)
+{
+    switch (node.get_type())
+    {
+    case fkyaml::node_type::BOOLEAN: {
+        boolean = node.as_bool();
+        return true;
+    }
+    case fkyaml::node_type::INTEGER: {
+        boolean = node.as_int();
+        return true;
+    }
+    case fkyaml::node_type::FLOAT: {
+        boolean = node.as_float();
+        return true;
+    }
+    case fkyaml::node_type::STRING: {
+        std::istringstream is(node.as_str());
+        is >> std::boolalpha >> boolean;
+        return true;
+    }
+    default:
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+} // namespace yaml
